cl.x: Provide Sika® Injection-222 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
Sika® Injection-222 is a single component flexible hydrophilic MDI based urethane injection grout. Sika® Injection-222 reacts with water to form a permanent flexible closed cell polyurethane seal.

cl.x: Sika® Injection-222 is typically injected by use of a single component pump that is designed for high pressure use.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
cl.x: Sika® Injection-222 is ready to use from the pail. Make sure product is pre-conditioned before use to an optimum 20-25ºC. If product has crystallisation due to low temperature storage, indirect heating and mixing using a power drill mixer paddle may be required before use.
